evidence: The body reports PowerToys 0.101.2684.0 x64 on Windows 11 build 26200, immediate PowerToys.exe exception 0xc0000409, admin launch failure, and reinstall without resolution.
The first public triage comment asks for concrete reproduction steps and a fresh PowerToys diagnostic ZIP.
The later author reply says Settings will not open, CmdPal settings changes fail, and the PowerToys process is not visible, but supplies no new build-specific reproduction or ZIP.
Needs-Author-Feedback remains on the open issue.
Dedupe Digest #50863 suggests #40205 and #41234; #40205 concerns Snapdragon X Elite/ARM64, and both remain open. No linked fix PR is present.
judgment.recommended_action: Preserve the existing author wait and inspect any diagnostic archive/reproduction details when supplied; do not treat the generic 0xc0000409 similarity as confirmed duplication.

fix_assessment.rationale: No separate code fix can be scoped from the current startup exception report while the already-posted diagnostics request remains unanswered; the possible duplicates do not establish an existing fix or a confirmed duplicate.
